verdict.rationale: Gumroad documents a public REST API for products, sales, subscribers and licenses, plus OAuth and MCP access for listing sales and checking payouts. Nothing in the pack covers failed-payment events, registrable webhooks, payment retries or dunning outreach. Subscriber and sales access is adjacent and does not deliver this story, and app-connection integrations do not count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
